patches.name: Branding
patches.description: Changes app name to 'CrimeRadar+' and tints the icon for easy identification.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Changes the app package name to allow installing alongside the original.

patches.name: Debug Settings
patches.description: Adds a CrimeRadar+ debug info entry to the settings screen.

patches.name: Notification Limits Raised
patches.description: Raises per-category daily push caps and heads-up push limits.

patches.name: Premium Bypass
patches.description: Bypasses premium subscription checks to unlock all premium features.

patches.name: Remove History Cap
patches.description: Removes the 200-item local reading history limit.

patches.name: Replay Minutes Override
patches.description: Overrides daily replay listening time limits to unlimited.

patches.name: Telemetry Kill
patches.description: Disables Instabug and Adjust telemetry SDKs for privacy.
